sources: Maturity chip look for launcher tiles (epic #15150). Every colour, radius and padding is a Sidekick design token name resolved against the active theme, so the chip follows theme changes and no hex literal lives in code. 'level_color_tokens' tints the border per level (levels in maturity_scale.json 'chip_hidden_levels' draw no chip). The chip height is fixed to the font line height plus twice the vertical padding and plus twice border_width_px, and its text never wraps, so adding a chip cannot change the height of the row that holds it at any card width (a narrow phone-width window previously grew and clipped the row).
